_note: Concept preview catalogue. Every product is a SAMPLE built on the concept imagery. No prices: they come from the client. Suits are modelled as separates: a jacket and trousers with their own size runs.

products.title: Mitcham charcoal suit
products.details: Two-button jacket with notch lapels, double vents and three interior pockets. Flat-front trousers with a side adjuster and an unfinished hem, taken up to your length in store.

products.title: Broadway navy suit
products.details: Slim two-piece in a pure wool twill. Narrow lapel, slanted pockets, tapered trouser. The interview suit.

products.title: Garratt grey suit
products.details: Classic regular-fit suit with a fuller chest and straight leg. Comfortable through a long day.

products.title: Tooting mid-grey three piece
products.details: Jacket, waistcoat and trousers in a mid-grey flannel. Wear all three for a wedding, the two piece for work.

products.title: Balham black trouser suit
products.details: Single-button blazer with a soft shoulder and a straight-leg trouser with a little stretch. Sized 6 to 20.

products.title: White easy-iron shirt
products.details: Semi-cutaway collar, double cuff option, easy-iron cotton poplin. Collars 14½ to 18, sleeves 33 to 36.

products.title: Fine blue stripe shirt
products.details: Slim-fit shirt in a fine blue stripe. Easy-iron.

products.title: Boys' navy suit
products.details: Two-piece navy suit for page boys, proms and communions. Matches the Broadway navy for a father-and-son pairing.

products.title: Spare trousers, Mitcham charcoal
products.details: A second pair in the same cloth doubles the life of the suit.

products.title: Made to measure
products.details: Your cloth, your cut. Twenty measurements, two fittings in Tooting.
